title: Belt & Bolt
license: CC0-1.0 / MIT (100% procedural Canvas & WebAudio synthesis, zero external binary dependencies)

visualAssets.description: 12x12 dark steel factory deck with subtle directional chevron overlays, coordinate labels, and glowing geometric ore veins (Copper Circle, Iron Square, Crystal Star).

Vector-rendered Extractor Miner, Conveyor Belt (1x), Overclocked Belt (2x cyan chevron), 1:1 Splitter, Alloy Cutter/Smelter, Capacitor Buffer Silo, Repair Wall, Bolt Turret, Scatter Turret, Arc Railgun, and Central Command Core.
shapez-inspired geometric items moving along belts: CuCircle (Copper), FeSquare (Iron), AuStar (Crystal Gold), CutHalf (Refined Copper Wedge), and BoltedAlloy (Refined High-Caliber Hex/Bolt).
Mindustry-inspired hostile wave units: Scout Crawler, Swarm Wasp, Armored Bruiser, Siege Crawler (Wave 15 Boss), Shielded Dreadnought (Wave 20/25 Boss), and Apex Goliath (Wave 30 Final Boss).

audioAssets.description: Pneumatic industrial clank when placing or rotating factory blocks.
Warm induction hiss and metallic stamp when Alloy Smelter refines raw ore.
Distinct kinetic pulse for Bolt Turret, dual burst for Scatter Turret, and high-voltage crack for Arc Railgun.
Two-tone industrial warning klaxon on wave launch and boss arrival.
